ten_negative_controls.statement: Each control runs an intentionally broken candidate through the real harness path and asserts the named check fires (tests/platform_harness/test_harness_mutants.py).

controls.name: wrong_dispatch
controls.broken_candidate: manifest declares accessibility, child analysis mutated to flow

controls.name: fake_backend_engagement
controls.broken_candidate: record claims backend_reported=native with no native module loaded

controls.name: missing_output / empty_comparison / failed_job
controls.broken_candidate: mutant deletes first output; empty dirs; failing child

controls.name: child_death_full_queues
controls.broken_candidate: worker SIGKILLs itself at 0.3 s with queue_depth=2 and 4 jobs
controls.expected: bounded window (elapsed << serial), status failed, killed child exitcode -SIGKILL recorded, assert_window_validated raises, no orphans left

controls.name: output_dir_reuse + committed_write
controls.broken_candidate: second run_id into finalized out-dir; child appends to a git-tracked file
controls.expected: OUTPUT_DIR_REUSE; SAFETY with file content unchanged after denied append

controls.name: thin_measurement_records
controls.broken_candidate: 5 record faces: parent-only memory, no memory, unsynced export, thin timings, fake accel claim, dropped-job counts
controls.expected: RECORD_AUDIT on every face (incl. dedicated simultaneous-tree memory check)

controls.name: oracle_provenance
controls.broken_candidate: 4 faces: filename-only reuse, missing fields, different reference build, self-oracle

controls.name: resource_ledger
controls.broken_candidate: enforced != declared workers; peak_inflight 4 > declared 1; sampler peak > memory_limit
